title: Siege of Constantinople (1422)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Constantinople (1422)", at revision 1376674680, opens: "In 1422, the Ottoman Empire laid siege to Constantinople, the capital of the Byzantine Empire, as a result of the Byzantine Emperor Manuel II's attempts to interfere in the succession of Ottoman Sultans, after the death of Mehmed I in 1421. This policy of the Byzantines was often used successfully in weakening their neighbours." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q700886, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1422 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
